pairing_result.reason: The supplement does not name 5FJ012705BR, edition 06.23 or another base-manual publication. It does not state that it replaces, corrects or supplements that specific base. Shared archive placement and number prefix are context, not a file-level pairing statement.
pairing_result.safe_use: Register both documents separately. Use the supplement only for its own topics and do not let it confirm or modify Lane Assist, Travel Assist, fatigue or traffic-sign chapters in the base manual.

base_manual_review.result: Overview identifies combined and equipment-dependent indications; detailed chapters control the exact state and driver instruction.

findings: The system evaluates driving behaviour only at about 65–200 km/h.
Detected fatigue produces a cup symbol, approximately five seconds of text and an acoustic warning; the message may be repeated once.
The driver must take regular breaks and must not drive tired; the system does not issue an acute warning for microsleep.
The exact reusable Tarraco cup graphic has not been established from the available licensed asset.
base_manual_review.catalogue_action: Meaning retained as pending exact graphic; no cross-model cup asset is asserted as exact.

findings: The camera-derived display is dynamic and may include speed limits, overtaking prohibitions, hazard signs and supplementary signs.
Country support and equipment/navigation affect the display; actual road signs remain authoritative.
base_manual_review.catalogue_action: No universal single warning card is created from a dynamic display.

verified_states: steady amber without exclamation: corrective steering intervention in progress
indicator extinguished: assistant may be switched on but not ready to intervene, or switched off; this is not a single publishable state
steady amber with message: Lane Assist unavailable; dirty/obstructed/damaged camera or fault may be responsible
base_manual_review.catalogue_action: Steady green active/available, amber corrective intervention and amber exclamation-mark unavailable states were scoped to their separate semantic cards after exact visual comparison. The extinguished indication remains unpublishable because the manual gives two alternatives: switched on but not ready, or switched off.

verified_states: green: Travel Assist active, distance control and adaptive lane guidance active
partly green: Travel Assist active, distance control active and adaptive lane guidance passive
grey: Travel Assist deactivated, no control
steady amber with message: unavailable or not operating as expected
white hands-on-wheel: take over steering after several seconds without hands
red hands-on-wheel: take over immediately after a longer hands-off period or system limits; sound or steering-wheel vibration may accompany it
base_manual_review.catalogue_action: Composite Travel states remain pending exact reusable graphics. White and red takeover requests were scoped to their separate semantic cards after exact visual comparison; amber unavailable remains pending its composite graphic.
